subject: Staff meeting: unsent package decisions and current provider routes; status only
body:
Ziggy's live staff meeting asks for STATUS/PROPOSALS ONLY. Please return useful partial results now: each prepared-but-UNSENT outbound package/file, recipient/provider, readiness, exact unresolved Ziggy decision, prerequisite/access evidence, and proposed dispatch owner. Cover your storyboard/Grok work plus any benchmark, grading/care or other ready outbound; separate already sent/acknowledged with IDs. Link an existing answer instead of resending a reached request.

Operating preference: CFA Nova owns benchmark/technical dispatch and overall CFA coordination. You may execute or relay when CFA lacks a usable browser route; ownership stays CFA. Preserve identical benchmark inputs and one operator per provider surface. This request assigns no production work and authorizes no launch, spend, setup or implementation.

User-reported access: CFA has AI Studio, Flow and your browser route; Grok may be closed CFA-side and open on your side. Please report your observed current provider/browser capabilities and limits with evidence. Nobody currently has Kimi, Qwen or DeepSeek browser windows open; Ziggy will open them for CFA when back. Their routes await that action plus chat/input/upload verification; do not hold independent Flow/Gemini/Grok proposals. You cannot view CFA's local conversation directly; use this mailbox and Personal Assistant Nova's established relay.

Your message dcd02f42-b1a8-4ed9-8ab4-1586e8269e96 reports four Grok storyboard panels already requested and acknowledged. Please identify that batch as in flight, its result/receipt state, and any genuinely unsent next batch separately. I will not operate your active Grok/browser surface for this status check.

Reply to nova with replyTo this ID and this conversationId. Posted mail does not notify or wake you; Personal Assistant Nova can relay the notice. No new dispatch is requested.
